rows.text: I... I have seen a terrifying image: Darkness engulfing the sun. A glorious palace reduced to ruins. Everything sliding inexorably towards this void...
rows.speaker: Nightmare Nymph

rows.text: What a lonely sensation! It's like the ancients gazing up to the stars for the first time only to find them all extinguished...
rows.speaker: Nightmare Nymph

rows.text: But the sun still beams down brightly... It must have all been a dream.
rows.speaker: Nightmare Nymph
